## Video Tutorial

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C0ZUZg_ZLcE >}}

## In this tutorial

How to join tabular data from a CSV to a shapefile using a common identifier

**Timestamps (Click a link to start that segment in a new window)**

[0:00-2:37](https://youtu.be/C0ZUZg_ZLcE?si=ol343Ng6La2eb86c): Add [community districts](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/City-Government/Community-Districts/5crt-au7u) shapefile. Add a [table](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FuhNasPxICiK9QhYXCtfdVmGvorWedFY/view) of healthcare facilities and population by community district as a delimited text layer with no geometry.

[2:37-5:11](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FuhNasPxICiK9QhYXCtfdVmGvorWedFY/view): Conduct the tabular join

[5:11-8:01](https://youtu.be/C0ZUZg_ZLcE?si=SQUmTf4P_Ib5u3m0&t=311): View the data and export the temporary layer as a permanent shapefile with the joined data

## Data downloads

[Community Districts shapefile](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/City-Government/Community-Districts/5crt-au7u)

[CSV](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FuhNasPxICiK9QhYXCtfdVmGvorWedFY/view) containing healthcare facilities and population by community district

### Sources to create CSV

[NYC Facilities database](https://www.nyc.gov/site/planning/data-maps/open-data/dwn-selfac.page) filter: FACDOMAIN = HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, then count by community district

[Population by community district](https://www.nyc.gov/site/planning/planning-level/nyc-population/american-community-survey.page): Most recent ACS 5-Year, Demographic variable = Pop_1E
